gloss: to deal with; to take notice of; to engage with

definitions.gloss: to deal with; to take notice of; to engage with; to pay attention to
definitions.explanation: To engage with or respond to someone. Very commonly used in the negative to mean ignoring someone or not giving them attention.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}にしない⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
だれも⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{相手|あいて}にしなかった。
examples.english: Nobody paid any attention to him.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦くだらない→くだらない：09416_kudaranai⟧⟦{挑発|ちょうはつ}→挑発：12827_chouhatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{相手|あいて}にする⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no need to engage with such petty provocation.

notes:
USAGE:
Most frequently used in the negative ({相手|あいて}にしない) to mean "to ignore" or "to not bother with." In the affirmative, it can mean to engage with, respond to, or deal with someone. Also used with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{相手|あいて}にする.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{相手|あいて}にする (to deal with ~)
- {相手|あいて}にしない (to ignore, to not engage)
- {相手|あいて}にされない (to be ignored)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無視|むし}する→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧: to ignore — more direct and deliberate
- ⟦{取|と}り{合|あ}う→取り合う：12000_toriau⟧: to deal with, to attend to — can also be used in negative for ignoring
